subject: Operational Compact: Temporary P1/P2 Weekend Delegation (Tidebridge)
messages:
From: Sam Caldwell <sam.caldwell@tidebridge.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary weekend P1/P2 response compact

Hi Grace,

We're planning a region-wide data migration for Tidebridge on May 30-31 to move traffic between clusters. The migration is low risk but it spans our US weekend window and we need an operational compact for P1/P2 response during that time.

Current ask: would Redwood accept a temporary SLA carveout for that weekend where:
- P1 response target: 90 minutes (instead of standard 30)
- P2 response target: 4 hours (instead of standard 2)
- On-call escalation: Tidebridge ops lead (me) + contracts inbox listed as notification targets

We're proposing to share run-of-show and we will have an engineer on-site; the carveout would be limited to 2026-05-30 00:00 to 2026-05-31 23:59 PDT. We understand credits don't apply automatically — we just need confirmation of the temporary compact and a named Redwood point of contact.

I've attached our migration MAP for context.

Appreciate a quick run-through and whether Redwood can accept under those constraints.

Thanks,
Sam Caldwell
Senior Ops Lead, Tidebridge
sam.caldwell@tidebridge.com
[Attachment: tidebridge-MAP-v3.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary weekend P1/P2 response compact

Team,

Forwarding request from Tidebridge (below). They want a bounded SLA exception for the May 30-31 migration window. Key asks: 90m P1 and 4h P2 for the weekend, plus a named escalation target (Sam).

My proposal: we accept a "temporary operational compact" with the following conditions:
- Exception limited to 2026-05-30 00:00 through 2026-05-31 23:59 PDT.
- Redwood will staff a dedicated weekend standby rotation: two engineers (one primary, one backup).
- P1 response commitment: 75 minutes from alert triage (we can tighten to 75m vs their 90m).
- P2 response: 4 hours.
- Full incident bridge and post-incident report within 48 hours.
- Any credit or SLA penalty language will require Sales/Legal sign-off (cc'ing Contracts is necessary).

Ben/Karthik — can one of you take lead for the weekend roster and runbook updates? Lauren, please confirm SRE escalation handoff if an incident needs pager expansion.

I'll draft the compact doc and send a confirmation to Tidebridge once we have internal sign-off.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary weekend P1/P2 response compact

Agree with Grace's approach. I can own the primary roster for that weekend and will staff the rotation with one primary and one secondary SWO (standby). Proposed operational details: 

- Primary SWO: first responder and initial triage. If not acknowledged in 30 minutes, secondary takes over.
- P1 triage timeline: aim to have a bridge up and first responder engaged within 30 minutes; commitment to customer 75 minutes for substantive response (investigation/mitigation plan).
- Escalation ladder: primary SWO -> SRE lead (Lauren) -> Head of Support (Grace) -> CTO (if incident breaches availability thresholds). We'll document thresholds (error rate, regional outage) in the compact.
- Communications: Tidebridge ops (Sam) + support@tidebridge.com will be notified on bridge creation; we'll copy contracts@tidebridge.com for transparency.

I'll update the weekend runbook and add a short checklist for the migration play (post-mortem ownership, logs snapshot, KV cache rollback steps). I'll also create a lightweight post-incident report template we can send within 48 hours.

Ben Carter
Senior Support Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 13:02:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary weekend P1/P2 response compact

Thanks — I can be the secondary for that weekend and will push the necessary runbook changes into the ops repo. A few operational clarifications from the SRE side:

- We'll instrument a temporary alert suppression rule for low-severity noise during migration, but P1/P2 alerts will remain unmuted.
- Bridge creation template: include incident id, migration step, responsible engineer, and customer contact block. Link to draft runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/ops/runbooks/weekend-migration-template
- I can accept the 75m P1 commitment, provided we codify an explicit exemption for scheduled migration windows and document the rollback trigger conditions.

I'll attach the compact PDF once Ben and I finalize the checklist.

Karthik Iyer
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rbwd-weekend-oncall-compact.pdf (pdf)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Caldwell <sam.caldwell@tidebridge.com>, support@tidebridge.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, contracts@tidebridge.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Operational Compact: Temporary P1/P2 Weekend Delegation (Tidebridge) — ACCEPTED (conditional)

Sam — thanks for the details and the MAP. Redwood accepts a temporary operational compact for the Tidebridge May 30-31 migration under the following agreed conditions: 

1) Scope and window: 2026-05-30 00:00 through 2026-05-31 23:59 PDT; applied only to migration activity documented in the attached MAP.
2) Response commitments: P1 substantive response within 75 minutes; P2 response within 4 hours. P1 includes bridge creation and an initial mitigation/action plan.
3) Coverage: Redwood will staff a two-person weekend standby (Ben — primary, Karthik — secondary).
4) Escalation path: primary SWO -> SRE lead (Lauren) -> Head of Customer Reliability (Grace) -> Redwood CTO (if availability breach).
5) Exemptions: automated noise suppression rules during migration; exceptions only apply to scheduled migration windows.
6) Post-incident: 48-hour post-incident report for any P1/P2 event; we will share RCA if root cause qualifies as service degradation under the contract.
7) Credits & contract language: any SLA credits or formal amendment require execution by Redwood Sales and Tidebridge Contracts (cc'd). This email is an operational acceptance, not a contract amendment.

Next steps: Ben will share the final weekend roster and the brief migration checklist; Karthik will publish the runbook update and bridge template; I'll send a signed operational compact doc to Tidebridge and copy Contracts for formal acknowledgement.

Attached: rbwd-weekend-oncall-compact.pdf (operational compact draft). HubSpot link to deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/TDG-4591

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
[Attachment: rbwd-weekend-oncall-compact.pdf (pdf)]
